entities.name: N. P. van Wyk Louw
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolaas Petrus van Wyk Louw, almost universally known as N.P. van Wyk Louw, was an Afrikaans-language poet, playwright and scholar. He was the older brother of Afrikaans-language poet W.E.G. Louw.
